summary: An interactive 3D WebGL web application featuring the 'Brant Airster T3', a hybrid trike/hover vehicle that shifts between road driving and flight modes, built with code generated by Claude Opus 5.5 using Three.js and bpy.
summaryEn: Interactive 3D Transforming Roadster Bike in Three.js and Blender bpy

post.originalText:
Inspired by @elonmusk's Roadster, I asked Claude to surprise me with a bike that could ride on roads and take off into the sky 

And damn, LOOK AT THIS THING. What a machine. Tesla might want to take some notes? 😉

Btw, it’s all code, and the way it switches between driving and flying feels so realistic.

Built with Claude Opus 5.5 🧡

Live: https://t.co/ooxWWMLeNi
